statement: A deterministic accretion guard seals the callback-axis production dependency census: every src/ reference to the partition_callback axis tokens (partition_callback, partitionCallback, PARTITION_CALLBACK, js_wasm_component_v1, CallbackExecutionHost, callback-execution-host, WasmCallAdapter, wasm-call-adapter) lies inside the sealed allowlist of axis-chain files committed beside the guard, WasmCallAdapter has zero production instantiations in src/, and the guard executes as a deterministic scenario so any new production dependency accreting onto the legacy callback axis turns the scenario red before it ships.
